Create one Gemventure terrain spritesheet for the PEDRA material family. The supplied material-template PNG is the GEOMETRY reference. The approved blue slime is the STYLE and elevated orthographic camera reference only; never depict the creature, eyes or its crystal.

STRICT ATLAS CONTRACT: 2048 x 2048 transparent PNG, 8 columns and 8 rows, 256 x 256 per cell. Preserve every stencil's alpha coverage, cell position, scale and ground anchor. Do not reinterpret, rotate the camera, respace or redraw the connection silhouettes. Paint within the existing masks. No headings, labels, grid lines, margins inside the stencil, scenery backdrop or drop shadow outside modules.

MATERIAL: Quiet broad gray stone surfaces and continuous rock cliffs. A few shallow broad cracks; no ores, jewels or piles of mineable boulders. Colors from Gemventure's family: base #686b72, lighter broad plane #8b97b6, one shadow family #353658; dark-purple silhouette contour #180d2f only where structurally needed. Match the approved softened geometric masses, broad matte bevel faces and restrained detail. Do not force extra highlights or perfectly harsh posterization that destroys the approved bevels. No bloom, glossy wet plastic, tiny facets, random spikes or photorealistic texture.

PERSPECTIVE: fixed elevated near-front orthographic view, near-horizontal U axis, V depth shifting slightly right. Never symmetrical diamond isometry. Floors are flat continuous surfaces; no extruded pedestal under each floor tile. NO dark outlines or perimeter bevel around connected interior floor cells. Volumetric walls and separate props can have the approved bold outer silhouette.

SLOTS, zero-based in reading order: 00–46 are the supplied 47 connection masks, including reentrant corners. 47–50 are vertical faces N/E/S/W. 51–54 are terminations N/E/S/W. 55–58 are stairs N/E/S/W for solid materials, or four water/magma surface-flow motifs for liquids. 59–62 are quiet full-surface variants A/B/C/D. 63 is a sparse matching overlay accent. Keep all anchor points unchanged. Liquid edges remain fixed; the four motifs are animation source frames, not permission to move the shoreline.

Exactly one material family, all geometry faithful to the supplied stencil, truly transparent empty pixels and clean antialiased coverage. The atlas will be checked against its masks; attractive shapes alone are not sufficient.
